# Psalm 104 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Let everything in me praise the LORD! LORD my God, you are incredibly great! You are dressed in splendor and majesty,

**2** wrapped in light like a robe, stretching out the sky like a tent.

**3** You build your home above the rain clouds; you ride the clouds like a chariot; you travel on the wings of the wind.

**4** You make the winds your messengers and flames of fire your servants.

**5** You set the earth on its foundations — it will never, ever be shaken.

**6** You draped the ocean over the earth like a blanket; the waters stood higher than the mountains.

**7** But at your command they ran away; at the crash of your thunder they fled.

**8** Mountains rose and valleys sank down to the places you assigned them.

**9** You drew a line the waters can never cross — they will never flood the earth again.

**10** You send springs flowing into the valleys; they wind between the mountains.

**11** Every wild animal drinks from them; wild donkeys come to quench their thirst.

**12** Birds nest along the banks; they sing from the branches.

**13** From your home above, you water the mountains. The whole earth is satisfied by what you produce.

**14** You grow grass for the cattle and plants for people to cultivate — bringing food up from the earth:

**15** wine to make their hearts happy, oil to make their faces glow, and bread to give them strength.

**16** The LORD's own trees drink deeply — the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.

**17** Birds build their nests in them; storks make their homes in the tallest branches.

**18** The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the cliffs are a safe place for rock badgers.

**19** He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows exactly when to set.

**20** You bring darkness, and night falls — that's when all the forest animals come out.

**21** The young lions roar as they hunt, asking God for their dinner.

**22** When the sun comes up, they sneak back to their dens and lie down.

**23** Then people head out to work and labor until evening.

**24** LORD, the list of things you've made is endless! You made every single one of them with wisdom. The earth is bursting with your creatures.

**25** And then there's the ocean — massive and wide — swarming with countless creatures, both small and enormous.

**26** Ships sail across it, and Leviathan — that creature you made just to play in the waves!

**27** Every living thing looks to you to feed them at the right time.

**28** When you provide, they gather it up. When you open your hand, they are filled with good things.

**29** When you turn away, they panic. When you take back their breath, they die and return to dust.

**30** When you send your Spirit, new life is created, and you make the whole earth fresh again.

**31** May the LORD's glory last forever! May the LORD take pleasure in everything he made —

**32** the one who just glances at the earth and it shakes, who touches the mountains and they erupt in smoke!

**33** I will sing to the LORD for my entire life; I will praise my God as long as I exist.

**34** May my reflections be pleasing to him — because I find my joy in the LORD.

**35** May sinners disappear from the earth and the wicked be no more. Let everything in me praise the LORD! Hallelujah!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **104:24-26**: This is pure wonder — the psalmist looks at creation and can't contain himself. And then the Leviathan detail: God made this terrifying sea monster just to splash around and play! That's a God with a sense of humor and absolute power.

- **104:29-30**: The rhythm of all life in two verses: God breathes out, things live. God breathes in, things die. God breathes out again, new things are created. Every breath you take is a gift on loan from God.

— PNEUMA
